recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Future work should revisit Flag.category only if Patient Care changes the intended filtering/display semantics or identifies a genuinely misleading source location.
issue_request: FHIR-6170 was a Published FHIR-core/Flag change request from Patient Care with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked to clarify that Flag.category is for filtering which flags are displayed to a particular user or context, rather than message content.
initial_application: The Jira comments record that the Flag.category documentation was updated in @6637. Git commit c112ec2e11af515a5d2e6b1806fa6350e188d22b explicitly references #6170 and added the filtering/display sentence to the old Flag spreadsheet source; later source migrations preserved that sentence in the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: Flag is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml already says Flag.category is intended for filtering which flags are displayed to a user or context, and the binding description says filtering/display purposes. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later final core decision or community discussion changing this interpretation.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The only remaining difference from the Jira resolution wording is editorial, not semantic, so duplicating or rewriting the clarification would not improve the current specification.
